description: How far an apply has got: steps created, updated, skipped, failed and left per resource type, the current phase, progress inside a Shopify bulk operation, time so far and an estimate of the time left, failures counted per resource type and reason, and the latest failures. Also answers for an apply that ended or was interrupted by a server restart. Call it after apply_plan returns a background apply, every minute or so until state is done or error. resource narrows only the listed failures; the counts always cover every resource type. For what each step wrote use get_audit_log, to stop the apply use cancel_apply, and for what was planned use get_plan.

failures.description: How many of the latest failures to list (default 20).

plan_id.description: The plan whose apply to report on. Default: the most recent apply.

resource.description: List only the failures of this resource type, e.g. products.

name: apply_status
title: Follow an apply
